hooks.name: Run full test suite after a spec task
hooks.description: After Kiro completes a task from .kiro/specs/expense-splitter/tasks.md, verify nothing regressed.

hooks.name: Money-safety review when the agent stops
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to self-check the money-handling steering rule before finishing.

action.prompt: Before finishing: confirm that no code you changed uses float for money (see .kiro/steering/money-handling.md) and that `uv run pytest -q` passes. If either is not true, fix it now.

hooks.name: Block destructive shell commands
hooks.description: Gate dangerous operations: refuse rm -rf and deleting the SQLite database.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=sys.stdin.read(); bad=['rm -rf','splitsmart.db']; sys.exit(2 if any(b in d for b in bad) else 0)"
